description: This source file implements bisecting functionalities in a version control context, handling commit traversal, reference management, and bisect logic for identifying bad revisions in a git repository.

methods.name: int count_distance(struct commit_list * entry)
methods.description: Calculates the distance of a commit or commit list from interest based on flags, used as part of the bisection heuristic.

methods.name: void clear_distance(struct commit_list * list)
methods.description: Resets the COUNTED flag on commits to prepare for a new distance calculation.

methods.name: int weight(struct commit_list * elem)
methods.description: Retrieves the weight value associated with a commit in the bisection heuristic.

methods.name: void weight_set(struct commit_list * elem,int weight)
methods.description: Assigns a weight value to a commit in the bisect heuristic.

methods.name: int count_interesting_parents(struct commit * commit,unsigned bisect_flags)
methods.description: Counts the number of interesting parent commits for a given commit, considering bisect flags.

methods.name: int approx_halfway(struct commit_list * p,int nr)
methods.description: Determines if a commit is approximately halfway in the traversal, based on heuristics.

methods.name: void show_list(const char * debug,int counted,int nr,struct commit_list * list)
methods.description: Displays the current list of commits with their flags and weights, primarily for debugging.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * best_bisection(struct commit_list * list,int nr)
methods.description: Selects the best candidate commit for bisecting based on the minimal distance heuristic.

methods.name: int compare_commit_dist(const void * a_,const void * b_)
methods.description: Comparator function for sorting commits by their distance to the target, for prioritizing bisect candidates.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * best_bisection_sorted(struct commit_list * list,int nr)
methods.description: Selects the best bisect candidate from a sorted array of commits based on custom heuristics.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * do_find_bisection(struct commit_list * list,int nr,int * weights,unsigned bisect_flags)
methods.description: Performs the core iterative process to find the appropriate commit for bisecting, considering distance heuristics.

methods.name: void find_bisection(struct commit_list ** commit_list,int * reaches,int * all,unsigned bisect_flags)
methods.description: Main function to determine the commit to test next for bisecting, managing heuristics and commit list.

methods.name: int register_ref(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data UNUSED)
methods.description: Registers references (refs) related to bisect, such as good, bad, or skipped revisions.

methods.name: int read_bisect_refs(void)
methods.description: Reads bisect-related references from the repository to initialize the bisect state.

methods.name: read_bisect_paths(struct strvec * array)
methods.description: Reads paths related to bisect configuration from files.

methods.name: char * join_oid_array_hex(struct oid_array * array,char delim)
methods.description: Converts an array of object IDs into a hex string joined by a delimiter.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * filter_skipped(struct commit_list * list,struct commit_list ** tried,int show_all,int * count,int * skipped_first)
methods.description: Filters out skipped commits based on stored skip lists and criteria, including optional random selection.

methods.name: struct:commit_list * managed_skipped(struct commit_list * list,struct commit_list ** tried)
methods.description: Manages the skipping of commits according to bisect configurations and heuristics.

methods.name: void bisect_rev_setup(struct repository * r,struct rev_info * revs,struct strvec * rev_argv,const char * prefix,const char * bad_format,const char * good_format,int read_paths)
methods.description: Sets up revision walking with the specified bad and good commits for bisecting.

methods.name: void bisect_common(struct rev_info * revs)
methods.description: Sets common options for revision walks in the bisect process.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error error_if_skipped_commits(struct commit_list * tried,const struct object_id * bad)
methods.description: Handles scenarios where only skipped commits remain, signaling failure.

methods.name: int is_expected_rev(const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Checks if a revision matches an expected revision stored in references.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_checkout(const struct object_id * bisect_rev,int no_checkout)
methods.description: Checks out the specified commit during bisecting, updating refs accordingly.

methods.name: struct:commit * get_commit_reference(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Retrieves a commit object given its object ID, or errors if invalid.

methods.name: struct:commit ** get_bad_and_good_commits(struct repository * r,size_t * rev_nr)
methods.description: Collects and returns the bad commit and all good commits involved in bisecting.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error handle_bad_merge_base(void)
methods.description: Handles cases where the merge base is bad or unexpected, providing user feedback.

methods.name: void handle_skipped_merge_base(const struct object_id * mb)
methods.description: Warns when a merge base should be skipped during bisecting.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error check_merge_bases(size_t rev_nr,struct commit ** rev,int no_checkout)
methods.description: Verifies merge bases for the current bisect operation, ensuring correct ancestry.

methods.name: int check_ancestors(struct repository * r,size_t rev_nr,struct commit ** rev,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Checks whether all specified revisions are ancestors of a given revision.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error check_good_are_ancestors_of_bad(struct repository * r,const char * prefix,int no_checkout)
methods.description: Ensures that all good revisions are ancestors of the bad revision, handling merge bases.

methods.name: void show_commit(struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Displays detailed commit information to the user.

methods.name: void read_bisect_terms(char ** read_bad,char ** read_good)
methods.description: Reads the terms used during bisect (e.g., 'bad', 'good') from configuration files.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_next_all(struct repository * r,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Main loop that advances the bisect process by selecting the next commit to test.

methods.name: int estimate_bisect_steps(int all)
methods.description: Estimates how many steps remain in the bisect process using logarithmic heuristics.

methods.name: int mark_for_removal(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Marks references for removal during cleanup.

methods.name: int bisect_clean_state(void)
methods.description: Removes all bisect-related state, references, logs, and configuration files, resetting the environment.
